concepts.label: Card Fan
concepts.prompt: Create ONE finished WORDLESS PIXEL ART LOGO concept for Launch a Card, a premium token + NFT trading-card launch platform. No text of any kind, no lettering, no numbers, no wordmark. Absolutely NO CROWN or royal headwear anywhere. Reference1 supplies the approved crisp pixel-art style, but its crown must be removed completely. References2-4 are the actual card backs on the site, which must supply the card artwork. Faithfully reinterpret them as deliberate beautiful 16-bit handheld Pokemon-era pixel art: golden Doge head / black and gold laurel back; blue vortex and gold frame with red-and-ivory ball back; emerald Pepe face with silver/opal ornamental frame. Use their actual identities and colors rather than inventing replacement patterns. Keep the important faces/ball recognizable. Gold, cream, charcoal, red, emerald, with blue confined to the existing ball-card artwork. High craft hand-placed square pixel clusters, consistent visible pixel scale, stepped crisp contours, strong dark outlines, limited deliberate palette and selective pixel highlights. No blurry downsampling or smooth 3D render with a pixel filter. The icon must work as a compact, memorable brand mark for an X/pump.fun avatar and website header. A SQUARE truly transparent canvas. Center the entire logo and keep it within the central 72 percent of both canvas dimensions, ample padding on all sides, complete silhouette safe inside a circular avatar crop. No background badge, painted checkerboard, floor, glow aura, cast shadow, coins, rocket, casino suits, crowns, labels or extraneous sparkles. One logo only, not a concept sheet, no mockup. CONCEPT A — THE SIGNATURE FAN. Only exactly THREE premium portrait card backs arranged into one beautifully balanced compact fanned hand, NO literal hand. Doge back left rotated -18 degrees, blue ball card at the center forefront upright, Pepe back right rotated +18 degrees. Both meme faces fully recognizable. Cards have consistent portrait proportions and crisp gold stepped edges. Rebalance the fan vertically now that the crown is gone: the fan itself is the entire emblem and must fill the central space cleanly, with no conspicuous empty hole at the top. No wrapper, no frame enclosing the fan, no album, no clasp. This is the simplest, strongest standalone brand logo.
